gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Hand-drawn and cheerful, Shantell Sans leads. Zen Maru Gothic follows in a plain sans that never snags, so a long read feels like following a single thread.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans opens every bowl with a generous channel, giving it a technical but friendly face. And Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib width, keeps the heading loose while the text underneath just keeps moving.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-zilla-slab: Expressive is the first word that comes to mind for Shantell Sans, whose curves are as thick as its straight stems. But Zilla Slab does the sturdier work, its slab-serif curves opening broadly to carry the text.
gen-gf-sniglet-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk draws its lines without any thick-and-thin modulation, which keeps it approachable and clean under the heading. Sniglet is the one with presence, while the body simply gets on with talking.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and casual, tightly spaced and tall. Over a longer stretch its curve endings stay well apart, so the sans-serif text feels snug yet never muddy, with ascenders that look short.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-familjen-grotesk: Lively from the first line, Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, which gives the text a light touch. And Sniglet, with terminals that stop short of curling, sets a commanding, level tone above it.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-hind: Level and commanding, Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back. Hind answers in a plain sans with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so the two feel like a loud voice beside a steady one.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-nunito: Approachable from top to bottom, this pairing is friendly. Sniglet holds a level, commanding beat in the heading while Nunito's big round lowercase bowls and open terminals make the sans text feel soft beneath it.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Warm comes first with Pilcrow Rounded, whose big counters and tall lowercase sit tightly spaced beneath the commanding, level Sniglet heading. That difference in lowercase height is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-quicksand: Quicksand brings tall lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs, with terminals finishing well clear of the stem. And across a longer stretch its bars keep a uniform thickness, so the plain sans text glides along beneath Sniglet.
